summary: Targeted pixel-contrast check and final render check of the Home exam cards after 2 token edits (BITSAT --exam-muted #281806, COMEDK --exam-muted #DDF5F1). Done only in the browser with read-only page.route('**/api/**') fixtures: 0 writes attempted, no backend/DB/auth/AI used. Method: html scroll-behavior forced to auto, window.scrollTo with behavior 'instant', then waited until scrollY was stable for 3 consecutive rAF checks. The bbox was read again after the scroll settled. Every card was fully visible below the sticky header: header bottom 87px on desktop and 77px on mobile; card tops 169 (desktop) and 89/89/250 (mobile). The mouse was parked off the cards (:hover=false). Only the card text, underline and link/CTA svg were made transparent. Screenshots were lossless PNG clipped to the card(s), decoded on a canvas with no JPEG, and the scale was taken from image px / CSS clip px (DPR=1, scale about 0.999-1.0). Every text-node rect was sampled pixel by pixel; sample counts are in the thousands to hundreds of thousands, never 0. 3 phases: static (::before opacity 0); forced peak glare (::before animation none, translateX -58%..+58% in 2% steps = 59 positions, opacity 1); and live real keyframe frames (31 on desktop, 65-71 per card on mobile, over a full 7s cycle). Results: BITSAT nav and COMEDK body now pass. JEE eyebrow, COMEDK eyebrow and JEE body (desktop) are still just under 4.5 at the exact peak-glare pixels.

measurements_worst_case.BITSAT_nav_results (dark bottom corner): desktop 5.85 (static = forced = live; the white glare only lightens amber, so it never lowers dark-ink contrast), mobile 5.85. Chapter practice link: 7.02 / 6.82. PASS (previous 4.04).
measurements_worst_case.BITSAT_body: 6.82 desktop / 6.89 mobile. PASS. Title 8.23-8.38, eyebrow 6.69-6.79, top label 5.81-5.88, CTA 14.02.
measurements_worst_case.BITSAT_hover: Computed colour of nav a:hover is rgb(31,18,3) = #1F1203, which is darker than the default, so contrast is at least the 5.85 above.
measurements_worst_case.COMEDK_body: Static 7.64/7.63. Forced peak-glare min is 4.84 at translateX -14% (p1 4.97) on both viewports. Live min is 6.87 desktop / 5.48 mobile. PASS (previous 4.26).
measurements_worst_case.COMEDK_eyebrow (accent #A7F3E8, unchange: Static 7.0. Forced peak min 4.44 at -12% (p1 4.53 desktop / 4.57 mobile). Live min 4.91 desktop / 4.72 mobile. FAILS 4.5 only at the exact peak-glare pixels (<1% of pixels). The old 10-position sampling missed this and reported 4.58.
measurements_worst_case.JEE_eyebrow (accent #FFC6CC, unchanged): Static 7.34. Forced peak min 4.42 desktop / 4.41 mobile at -14% (p1 4.49/4.50). Live min 5.75 desktop / 4.51 mobile. This is a real value below 4.5, not JPEG noise or rounding: it was measured on lossless PNG and the worst background pixel is about rgb(99,92,94).
measurements_worst_case.JEE_body (#DED0D5): Forced peak min 4.47 desktop (p1 4.61) and 4.63 mobile. Live min 6.61 / 4.69. Desktop is marginally below 4.5 at the exact peak pixel only.
measurements_worst_case.all_other_text: JEE: title >= 6.02, top label >= 5.86, nav >= 6.22, CTA 6.09. COMEDK: title >= 5.12, top label >= 5.28, nav >= 5.88, CTA 9.45. All pass.

final_render.overflow: documentElement and body horizontal overflow are 0 at both 1920x800 and 390x844. Mobile cards span 20->370px.
final_render.palette: BITSAT is the bright amber gradient #FFC15B/#EF9B25/#D88015 with ink #281806 and an obsidian CTA with ink #FFF5DE. COMEDK is the teal gradient #04181A/#0A2025/#063A3E with body #DDF5F1, a #DFF9F3->#9CDCD5 CTA and ink #063733. JEE ruby is unchanged (#1A070A/#0D0C10/#24090E, CTA #B6112A, body #DED0D5). The hero is still royal blue (#06112E->#0B1D4F->#18357A->#091333, border #8498C0) with the silver CTA and 100% AI ribbon. These were checked visually in the final viewport screenshots and through computed CSS.
final_render.note: The desktop JEE card is 421px wide and BITSAT/COMEDK are 397px. This is intentional from grid-template-columns 1.06fr 1fr 1fr and is not a bug.

action_items: Optional (the user did not ask for JEE palette changes): to clear AA during peak glare, either lower the Home shine stripe peak alpha in '.exam-home .bold-exam-card:before' from rgb(255 255 255 / .17) to about .13, or lighten only the eyebrow inks slightly (COMEDK --exam-accent toward #BDF7EE, JEE --exam-accent toward #FFD3D8, JEE --exam-muted toward #E6DADE). Static contrast is already 7+:1 for all of these.
No action is needed for BITSAT nav/body or COMEDK body. Both token edits are verified by pixel measurement.
critical_code_review_comments: The main agent's earlier measurement artifact (BITSAT 100:1, COMEDK 3901:1) was caused by stale or offscreen bboxes. This run re-reads the bbox after an instant, settled scroll and asserts full visibility and sample count > 0. Reuse /app/tests/ui_contrast_measure150.py.
